title: Purpose-built liquid handler
tables: An 8/12-channel pipetting and dispensing module optimized for serial dilution and inoculation.
Builds broth microdilution layouts, dispenses reagents and executes bounded research protocols.
Direct MIC and repeatable research require liquid-handling consistency and traceability.
A constrained module can be safer and more economical than embedding a broad third-party robot, but pipetting accuracy, carryover and contamination controls must be validated.
